```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Read Graph File
We are using the well-known social network of `Zachary's karate club`, which ships with igraph as a named graph (`make_graph("Zachary")`). A GML format file can also be collected from [here](https://gist.github.com/pravj/9168fe52823c1702a07b).

```{r, results = 'hide'}
library(plotly.core)
library(igraph)

G <- make_graph("Zachary")
V(G)$label <- paste("Member", seq_len(vcount(G)))
L <- layout_in_circle(G)
```

### Create Vertices and Edges
```{r, results = 'hide'}
vs <- V(G)
es <- as.data.frame(as_edgelist(G))

Nv <- length(vs)
Ne <- length(es[1]$V1)
```

### Create Nodes
```{r, results = 'hide'}
library(plotly.core)

Xn <- L[, 1]
Yn <- L[, 2]

network <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = Xn,
    y = Yn,
    mode = "markers",
    text = vs$label,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  )
```

### Creates Edges
```{r, results = 'hide'}
network <- network |>
  # igraph also has an add_shape()
  plotly.core::add_shape(
    type = "line",
    line = go_shape_line(color = "#030303", width = 0.3),
    x0 = Xn[es$V1],
    y0 = Yn[es$V1],
    x1 = Xn[es$V2],
    y1 = Yn[es$V2]
  )
```

### Create Network
```{r}
network |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Karate Network",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(
      title = "",
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showticklabels = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(
      title = "",
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showticklabels = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    )
  )
```

### Reference
See `go_scatter()` and `go_shape()` for more information and chart attribute options!
